title: Graphon, which wants to resolve AI agent memory limitations by mapping connections across docs, videos, and images, raised a $35M Series A led by RRE Ventures (Shubhangi Goel/Business Insider)
summary: Shubhangi Goel / Business Insider: Graphon, which wants to resolve AI agent memory limitations by mapping connections across docs, videos, and images, raised a $35M Series A led by RRE Ventures — AI agents can write code, search databases, and carry out multistep tasks. But they can still lose track of past conversations …
